# Billero

> Mobile invoicing for sole proprietors, freelancers and one-person businesses,
> including single-owner LLCs. Version scope of this page: Billero 1.8.1.

Billero creates PDF invoices and quotes on iOS and Android. Basic use requires
no Billero account. Invoices, customers and settings are stored locally on the
device. Optional OCR sends the selected document to an external AI provider;
crash diagnostics and app-store purchases also use external services. See the
privacy policy for details.

## Product facts

- Free in version 1.8.1: the first 10 invoices and quotes combined, up to five
  customers and five OCR scans per month. Converting a quote to an invoice does
  not use an additional slot. Free PDFs have a Created with Billero watermark.
- Plus: unlimited documents and customers, no PDF watermark, recurring invoices,
  50 OCR scans per month and a weekly automatic backup protected by a password.
- Pro: Plus features, multiple companies with separate data and a combined
  company overview, and unlimited OCR scans.
- The app has 12 interface languages and 53 entries in its country catalog.
  These counts do not imply legal compliance or identical features everywhere.
  Italy is present in the catalog but is not selectable in the business profile.
- The issuer's country determines the available document fields and formats.
  United States and Canadian issuers use English PDF documents; the app interface
  can use another language, including Spanish for the United States.
- Payment QR options include UPN for Slovenia, SEPA EPC for supported European
  transfers and a QR code for the user's own payment link. Payment providers
  process payments; Billero does not operate a payment service.
- Billero does not submit invoices to tax authorities, perform fiscalization or
  issue structured e-invoices. A Mexican PDF is not a CFDI and has no tax validity.
- Billero does not replace an accountant or tax adviser. Prices and subscription
  billing periods are shown in the user's app store.

## Invoice requirements by country

Practical guides checked against official sources on November 23, 2026.
The guides distinguish legal requirements from useful additions and explain
Billero’s limits. They are general information, not legal or tax advice.

- [Kaj mora vsebovati račun v Sloveniji](https://billero.app/sl/racun-vsebina)
- [Invoice requirements: Slovenia](https://billero.app/en/invoice-requirements/slovenia)
- [Invoice requirements: United States](https://billero.app/en/invoice-requirements/united-states)
- [Invoice requirements: Germany](https://billero.app/en/invoice-requirements/germany)
- [Pflichtangaben auf Rechnungen](https://billero.app/de/rechnung-pflichtangaben)
- [Requisitos de facturas en EE. UU.](https://billero.app/es/factura-requisitos/estados-unidos)
